reviews.text: Tarot. Love it!

Expensive for no reason, and developer is arguing with me misleading about pricing. Rude.. Anything worthwhile in this app is behind a steep paywall.

The response is also rude. I’m not the only one who thinks 4.99 a week is steep. It is not a free world, people also don’t have to use or like your app because of the price and share that in a review. I found better ones out there that have more free features, and the paid service isn’t so expensive. And the things you pay for are things you can’t do for free. I can go read my tarot in a real deck, and get the meanings from the booklet. But paying to have horoscope, or practice games I can’t do for free. People don’t want to pay 4.99 a week to do what they can do for free. Does that make sense?

You’re being purposefully misleading about pricing. It is not 3 a month. It’s 4.99 a week, or you can pay 7.99 a month. Or you can pay 39.99 a year. There is no option to pay $3 a month. You HAVE to spend nearly $40 to get that “discount”. And it’s weird to argue with people giving you feedback on your app. I think it’s a bad app. And I would have liked to know before I installed. You charge whatever you want idc, if it’s working for you then cool. That doesn’t mean people unhappy with your app can’t leave their feedback. I absolutely do think it is a 1 star app. From pricing, to features, to the icon being exactly the same as another app in the App Store. And I only added why I thought it was not good, because you argued with me on my opinion on your app. So I was clarifying I found better apps that offer a more reasonable paywall, or had more features free. And explained when you paywall things that anyone can do for free in real life, to me is expensive for no reason. And saying you’re being respectful does not mean you’re being respectful. Starting your argument to my review, (a review in an App Store is an opinion based on their experience) “absolutely not” is not respectful. If you are not open to feedback then don’t read the reviews.. and I never said the majority of people didn’t like your app, but I definitely am not the only 1 star review.

I just read through and see you argue with other bad reviews too! Lol that is so bizarre. And just because you don’t like the review does not mean it isn’t valid. My original review was - it is too expensive for no reason. Everything worthwhile is behind a paywall. You decide to argue with me because you don’t agree as if being rude would make me leave a positive review. Tripping.

Unusable unless you pay for unreasonable subscription, Uses AI Art. If the purpose of having card meanings im app to be useful and easier than checking your decks pamphlet or doing a google search, then why is it easier to use the pamphlet/google search??? You can only check up to about four-ish cards before you’re locked behind an unreasonable paywall. At that point why not just use the booklet that comes with most decks? Why not just do a quick google search? Why would i have to pay four dollars a WEEK to just simply check the meaning of a card? I understand locking courses under a paywall, but card meanings? The functionality of this app is based upon how much money you give them per week/month/year. 

The only reusable aspect of this app is its ability to check card meanings, a reference for card layouts, and tests to strengthen your card knowledge. All of these features are locked behind a paywall. All of this information can be found online for free EASY. If your argument is that they deserve money for assembling all these resources in an easy to use app, then you are absolutely correct but the app shouldnt be on a subscription, it should be on a one time purchase of about four-ten dollars max(minus the courses). the only thing most likely worth forty dollars is the courses, which should be a SEPARATE one time deal to unlock them all. It makes absolutely no sense that users would have to pay weekly, monthly, or yearly for something so simple. 
Also, it uses AI art which is not only morally wrong but goes against everything magick and divination. Magick and divination is an extremely personal and complex process. AI art is soulless and has no meaning, tarot is filled with symbolism and detail, its lovingly hand crafted with nuance. The use of AI for their visual identifiers goes against principle with tarot and magick. What an insult to the craft.
WORST APP EVER. There are ads every 3 seconds. Can’t even use the features without a money grab
